hooks.name: spec-task-property-link
hooks.description: UNVERIFIED FORMAT: replace with the file Kiro writes when recreated in the Agent Hooks UI. When the agent writes a spec's tasks.md or design.md, check traceability: every property in design.md has a required (non-optional) test task that names it and its 'Validates' requirements, and every task cites requirement ids. The checker script is created in haunted-ui task 1 (scripts/spec-lint.ts); until it exists the hook says so instead of passing silently.

action.command: if [ -f scripts/spec-lint.ts ]; then pnpm -s spec:lint; else echo 'spec-lint not created yet (haunted-ui task 1): property links NOT checked' >&2; exit 1; fi
